evidence.detail: rs/p implements the classic procedural tile-height function: three octaves at periods 4/2/1 with offsets 45365/91923 and 10294/37821, weighted -128 normalization, 0.3 scaling +35, then clamping to 10..60.
The same class owns interpolated noise, smoothed neighborhood noise, the x + y*57 integer noise hash with constants 15731/789221/1376312589, and cosine interpolation.
Its static initializer builds 2048-entry fixed-point sine/cosine tables using 65536 scaling and 0.17578125-degree steps; the interpolation path indexes the cosine table at t*1024/period.
R53 ObjectManager calls rs/p.a(x,z) for procedural terrain heights when a terrain tile has no explicit height opcode, then negates/scales the returned 10..60 height into the scene heightmap.

Public deobfuscated RuneScape source preserves class PerlinNoise with the same getTileHeight, interpolatedNoise, smoothNoise, integer noise hash and cosine interpolation pipeline; 317 SceneBuilder/ObjectManager lineage contains the identical algorithms.

candidates.note: PerlinNoise is backed by an exact-v308 five-function terrain-noise contract and matching public deobfuscated lineage. Exact v308 remains the semantic authority.
